characters.name: Hiccup
characters.description: A young Viking boy who dreams of becoming a dragon hunter but instead befriends a dragon.

characters.name: Toothless
characters.description: A rare and powerful Night Fury dragon who becomes Hiccup's loyal best friend.

characters.name: Astrid
characters.description: A brave and skilled Viking girl who trains alongside Hiccup and becomes his closest ally.

characters.name: Stoick
characters.description: Hiccup's strong and proud father who is the chief of the Viking village of Berk.

media.label: How to Train Your Dragon poster

translations.title: How to Train Your Dragon (2010)
translations.description: A young Viking named Hiccup secretly befriends a dragon called Toothless, changing everything his village believes about dragons.
translations.history: The movie is inspired by Viking culture from Scandinavia, and the island of Berk is based on the rugged landscapes of Norway.

translations.title: Huyền Thoại Kỵ Sĩ Rồng (2010)
translations.description: Một cậu bé Viking tên Hiccup kết bạn với một con rồng tên Toothless, thay đổi tất cả những gì làng của cậu tin về rồng.
translations.history: Bộ phim được lấy cảm hứng từ văn hóa Viking ở Scandinavia, và hòn đảo Berk được xây dựng dựa trên phong cảnh hiểm trở của Na Uy.
